items.headline: US futures rebound as battered AI stocks recover
items.summary: Reuters reported that U.S. stock-index futures rebounded as investors returned to AI-linked shares after the prior week's selloff. The report cited ongoing concerns about slower AI-related spending and leadership uncertainty at Nvidia.
items.tag: AI equities; market rebound; capex risk

items.headline: AI spending slowdown raises questions about the next phase of the trade
items.summary: Axios reported that the AI investment trade is facing a potential shift from expectations of continually increasing capital expenditure toward scrutiny of whether AI spending is producing monetization and revenue returns.

items.headline: CrowdStrike to acquire Zscaler in an all-stock transaction valued at $44 billion
items.summary: The Associated Press reported that CrowdStrike agreed to acquire Zscaler in a deal that would combine two cybersecurity platforms. The article linked the transaction to rising security demands as AI agents expand the attack surface.

items.headline: CrowdStrike-Zscaler deal highlights consolidation in AI-era cybersecurity
items.summary: The proposed combination would create a larger cybersecurity platform spanning endpoint and cloud-security capabilities, according to AP reporting, with management citing the growing importance of zero-trust controls as AI agents become more widely used.

items.headline: Technology shares recover in premarket trading after a sharp AI-led selloff
items.summary: AP reported that Nvidia, Broadcom and Advanced Micro Devices rose in premarket trading after bearing much of the previous week's selling pressure.

items.headline: Broadcom participates in early-session rebound across AI-linked shares
items.summary: AP reported that Broadcom was among the AI-related stocks recovering before the U.S. market open following the prior week's selloff.
